title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Oct retail sales +0.2% MoM vs +0.8% prior — consumer demand cooling under sticky prices.
Oct industrial production +0.9% MoM — manufacturing & utilities beat; above prior +0.7%.
Nvidia Q3 FY2027 results after-close tonight: $109B rev / $2.47 EPS consensus (prior $96B).
FOMC minutes (Oct 27-28 mtg) due tomorrow 14:00 ET — market watching for Dec 9 hike debate.
